items.model_en: I was auditing Mike's profile when I noticed the wrong record type. By the time he reported it, the task had already been created twice, even though he'd never been given that permission. If PipeLaunch had respected the profile defaults, none of it would have happened, which is why I've asked for a guard on the pipeline.
